content:
**The Most Sensational Game** is an Expedition in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update. [1] 

The Expedition can be broken down into three main areas:

The Expedition consists of 2 mandatory randomized objectives, and 3 side objectives that provide additional rewards if completed. As opposed to Expeditions: The Pitt, Atlantic City Expeditions consist of 3 main objectives rather than 2. This means there are 6 different mandatory objectives, as each mandatory objective has three different possibilities.

### Side Objectives[edit]

- Emote after killing a competitor (10 required)
- Complete Expedition within 15 minutes of beginning the first objective
- Find missing Teddy Bear within the Showman's Pier/Arcade

## Main Objectives[edit]

### Part 1: The Boardwalk[edit]

At the beginning of the Expedition, the player will arrive on the Boardwalk of Atlantic City. The player character will be instructed to talk to Veracio Cruz, and then to the Batsuuri Twins. After talking with both parties, the player character will be instructed to go towards the starting area of the game indicated by a circular map marker, in which the player is then given 1 of 3 objectives:

- Kill 3 Overgrown Moonflowers. These are Overgrown enemies that will be marked by a circular map marker and have a blue aura/mist around them. The Overgrown can regenerate health fast when grouped.

- Kill an Overgrown Keeper. The keeper will be marked by a diamond map marker. After the player character kills and loots the key from the Overgrown Keeper's corpse, they are then instructed to unlock 2 prisoners cages (also indicated by a diamond map marker).

- Launch 7 fireworks scattered around the area. These will always be in a set pattern and indicated by diamond map markers. Kill the enemies near the firework as it activates, avoiding stagger and interruption.

After completing any of these objectives, the player is then tasked with entering the Showman's Pier/Arcade to continue the Expedition. Most objectives will lead you towards the entrance of The Showman's Pier/Arcade, but it is marked with a diamond map market regardless.

### Part 2: Showman's Pier/Arcade[edit]

Upon the player character entering The Showman's Pier/Arcade, the player will see three rooms connected by double doors. 

At the entrance to the third and final room, the player character will face a mandatory fight with one of the Batsuuri Twins. This can be either of them. The twin will be waiting by a pool table at the entrance of the third room, behind a double set of doors. 

After downing the twin, the aquarium entrance can be found in the room directly behind where the twin was initially waiting for the player. It will be marked with a diamond map marker. 

The optional objective to find the teddy bear becomes active in this second part of the Expedition. The teddy bear can come in four different variations, each with its own set spawn location. Collecting the teddy bear immediately rewards the player with 100 caps, regardless of whether they finish the Expedition or not. They possible teddy bears are:

- Teddy Fear - Appears at the far back right corner of the 2nd room. The teddy will be in a trashcan on the upstairs floor at the end of the hallway.
- Bubblegum Bear - Appears in the center of the 3rd room, the same room the Batsuuri Twin waits for the player character. It can be found on the left-hand side of the counter directly behind where the Batsuuri Twin is waiting (left-hand side refers to looking south from the position you spawn in facing, towards the entrance).
- Polar Bear - Appears at the center left of the 2nd room. A counter with a cash register and two white fridges can be found on the lower floor. The teddy spawns in the right fridge, the fridge without a door.
- Quantum Bear - Appears at the left side of the double doorway to the 3rd room. It will be sitting on top of a red rocket sit-on ride to the left of the entrance to the room in which the player character find one of the Batsuuri Twins waiting.
- Comrade Chubs - 1st room, upstairs, in a red Whac-a-Commie game, on the left when entering from outside.

### Part 3: The Aquarium[edit]

The final part of the Expedition takes the player character to the Aquarium. Upon entering the Aquarium and walking down the staircase on the right-hand side from the starting point, the player is given 1 of 3 objectives. These are: 

- To hold the flag in the Shark Den. The player character will be tasked with interacting with a flag in an area near the end of the aquarium. Once the player character has interacted with the flag (marked by a diamond map marker), enemies will precede to spawn on the lower floor of the room. They can spawn from either door used to enter the den (south and North-west of the flag) or from the area the player character continues on to fight the Batsuuri twins (North-east of the flag). Any enemies within the room will stop the claim area timer, and the room must be cleared before the timer will resume.
- To protect an escortee. A friendly NPC will run towards objectives and require to be defended against waves of enemies. The player character must defend the friendly NPC on three different occasions and cannot leave vicinity of the NPC or it will halt the progress of the timer.
- To throw tatos at the naughty Showmen in the Siren Theatre. Upon entering the room, three baskets of tatos will be marked with a diamond map marker. The player character is required to throw the tatos as grenades at the marked showmen. There are four showmen, and each requires three tatos to properly shame and complete the objective, meaning a total of 12 tatos must be collected and thrown. Waves of enemies spawn after each showmen is shamed.

After the player character completes any of the above objectives, they are then tasked with fighting both of the Baatsuri Twins simultaneously once they reach the final show room of the aquarium, where Mother Charlotte and Veracio Cruz are found. 

After defeating both of the twins, talking to Mother Charlotte upstairs will teleport the player character back to the pier, with a short run back to the vertibird to depart and complete the Expedition.

## Rewards[edit]

- On first Expedition the player character attempts, talking to Veracio and the Batsuuri Twins is a mandatory objective. After completing The Most Sensational Game at least once, it will become an optional objective. There is no reward penalty for failing to talk to both NPCs again and immediately starting the game, so it can be skipped.
- The mission timer for additional reward does not reset if you leave the Expedition or crash for any reason, unlike the other Expeditions.
- There is no need to kill competitors before the Aquarium area. Regardless of what objective you receive, you can easily get the emoting after competitor kills side objective finished within just the Aquarium alone.
- You only need to kill enemies surrounding the first 3-4 fireworks to prevent stagger. Both firework location 5 and 6 are relatively safe to launch without worry of stagger, and you can launch 7 while ignoring enemies if quick enough.
- When defending the escortee in the Aquarium, it is recommended not to walk in front of them. The NPC is prone to confusion and can ignore objectives for a while if their pathing is messed up, so it is best to trail a bit behind the NPC to help prevent this.
- During the shame the showmen objective, tatos can be thrown more easily and faster from the center top basket if rank 1 or higher of fire in the hole is equipped.
- The tato box on the upstairs left for the Siren Theatre objective within the Aquarium can be reached via a large hole in the wall. It possible to reach each of the showman from this area, before jumping back upstairs using the hole in the wall to collect another tato.
 - Only one tato can be carried at a time.

## Appearances[edit]

The Most Sensational Game appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.
